Qor client Tor runtime third-party notices
==========================================

The Linux ARM64 client archive contains Qor's pinned Tor 0.4.9.11 build and
its private runtime libraries from the authenticated Qor edge runtime.

Tor 0.4.9.11, with Qor's hidden-service descriptor publication patch
  Source: https://dist.torproject.org/tor-0.4.9.11.tar.gz
  Patch: docker/tor/patches/0001-retry-hsdesc-upload.patch
  License: BSD-3-Clause and other permissive licenses detailed in Tor's LICENSE.

Lyrebird 0.8.1
  Source: https://gitlab.torproject.org/tpo/anti-censorship/pluggable-transports/lyrebird
  Commit: 0b10edbb61e0ca6fb70c7d57aeaabf315f1fade1
  License: BSD-2-Clause, with GPL-3.0-or-later components described by the
  upstream LICENSE and LICENSE-GPL3.txt files.

The private OpenSSL, zlib, libevent, xz/liblzma, and zstd runtime libraries
originate from the pinned Ubuntu 22.04 edge-runtime build base. Their copyright
and license records are available from the corresponding Ubuntu source packages.
